title: Your Payments Just Got Smarter: Introducing Truly Offline UPI
description: A new way to pay, called UPI Lite X, lets you send and receive money even without internet. It uses NFC technology, similar to how you tap your card for payme.

faq.q: How do I enable UPI Lite X on my phone?
faq.a: You will typically find the option to enable and load your UPI Lite X wallet within your existing UPI payment app (like PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, etc.), provided your bank and the app support it.

faq.q: Is there a fee for using UPI Lite X?
faq.a: Currently, there are no transaction fees for using UPI Lite X for users. It's designed to be a cost-effective way to make small payments.

faq.q: What if my phone is lost or stolen?
faq.a: Since UPI Lite X is an on-device wallet, it's important to secure your phone with a strong lock. If your phone is lost, you should immediately block your UPI account and report it to your bank, similar to how you would with a lost debit card.

faq.q: Can I receive money offline with UPI Lite X?
faq.a: Yes, UPI Lite X is designed for both sending and receiving money offline, provided both devices are NFC-enabled and have the feature active.

faq.q: How is UPI Lite X different from regular UPI Lite?
faq.a: Regular UPI Lite allows for small value transactions without a PIN, but it still requires an internet connection for the transaction to go through. UPI Lite X specifically enables transactions even when both the sender and receiver are completely offline, using NFC technology.
